scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc
scripts.coverage: npm run build && node -e "if (!process.env.TEST_DATABASE_URL) throw new Error('TEST_DATABASE_URL required: a cobertura inclui o PostgreSQL (veja README)')" && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='dist/src/**/*.js' --test-coverage-lines=80 --test-coverage-branches=75 --test-coverage-functions=75 "dist/test/**/*.test.js"
scripts.coverage:lcov: npm run build && node -e "if (!process.env.TEST_DATABASE_URL) throw new Error('TEST_DATABASE_URL required: a cobertura inclui o PostgreSQL (veja README)')" && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=dist/lcov.info "dist/test/**/*.test.js"
scripts.test:db: npm run build && node -e "if (!process.env.TEST_DATABASE_URL) throw new Error('TEST_DATABASE_URL required')" && node --test "dist/test/db/*.test.js"
